## History

Following an academic return to school after her separation from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) entered a fierce rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and enjoyed secret exchanges with her friend. By October, she thrived under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shared her school experiences and upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), receiving warm encouragement from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remained skeptical of the concert's value.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are schoolmates who share a friendship centered around exchanging poetry. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), she continues her academic and social life alongside her peers as they prepare for school events.
